body:
Better Create is a modpack that enhances the Create mod experience with add-ons and complementary mods.

You can build a factory with the Create mod, a farm with Farmers Delight, organize your chests with Simple Storage Tom's Simple Storage, carry your items in a backpack, and bring Minecraft features back to previous versions with a single, optimized modpack that includes additions for the Create mod, allowing you to unleash your imagination.
